handoff.note: Decided: keep Node + fallback.md for no-Node envs. Rejected: Python port, Go/Rust binaries, JS single-exe, Cosmopolitan. Node floor is now 18: the full suite (50 tests, incl. build+site after a clean npm ci in docker node:18/20/22-alpine) passes, and the installer + CLI were smoke-tested on 18/20. engines/.nvmrc/lockfile = 18, README Install notes it; CI uses .nvmrc so it tests the floor. Local node_modules has a macOS tsc binary, so build/web tests fail here; use docker + npm ci. A failing hook (missing node) doesn't block edits in Claude Code, so fallback.md must carry the soft gate. Next: write skills/bubble/fallback.md.
